name: Sidebar nav
summary: Vertical navigation with group headings, icon and label items, badges, collapsible groups and an icon rail.
description: Use it for the main navigation of an app with many sections. Collapsible groups are native <details>, so they work without JavaScript. The icon rail keeps the labels for screen readers.

classes.name: v-sidenav
classes.description: The navigation, on a <nav>. Styles its lists, links and summaries.

classes.name: v-sidenav-label
classes.description: The item text. Takes the free space so a badge sits at the end.

classes.name: v-sidenav-rail
classes.description: Icons only. Labels and headings stay for screen readers; badges become a small count on the icon.

states.description: On the link to the current page: tinted with the accent.
On a <details> group: shows its links and turns the chevron up.

keyboard.action: Moves through the links and group headers.
On a group header, opens or closes the group.

a11y: Give the <nav> an aria-label, and a different one if the page has more than one navigation.
Mark the current page with aria-current="page".
In the rail, every link keeps its .v-sidenav-label text, so it still has a name. Add a tooltip for sighted users if the icons are not obvious.
A badge is read as part of the link text, so make it meaningful (12 unread, not only 12) with .v-sr-only text where needed.
